intro.text: SKINMED SPA + BODY is Port Jefferson's chic black-and-white skin studio on East Main Street, with its sister studio SKINMED BODY around the corner on Mariners Way. Start with a custom skin analysis, then follow a plan built for your skin: facials, laser hair removal, body contouring and wraps, plus memberships that keep your glow on schedule. Free parking is right behind the building.
